# Read Primitives — ANY_VALUE Simple

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Select any customer name per market segment (faster than MIN/MAX)

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
-- Select any customer name per market segment (faster than MIN/MAX)
SELECT
    c_mktsegment,
    ANY_VALUE(c_name) as sample_customer,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count
FROM customer
GROUP BY c_mktsegment;
```
